newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management to buy Reserve Iron.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management to buy Reserve Iron.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Tuesday it will acquire the assets of Reserve Iron & Metal L.P. in a deal valued at about $34 million.

Metal Management said it will also assume about $1.6 million worth of promissory notes and an unspecified amount of the Cleveland-based metal recycler's debt. A spokesman said the deal is expected to close by the end of the month.
Metal Management owns metal recycling operations in Phoenix, Houston and Los Angeles.
Its shares were up 1/8 Tuesday at 8-1/8.
